wikidot5e:wondrous-items:talisman-of-the.effectSummary: While holding it, double your proficiency bonus on Intelligence (Arcana) checks to control a sphere of annihilation. If you start your turn controlling one, use an action to move it 10 feet + 10 × Intelligence modifier feet.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:talisman-of-ult.effectSummary: A neutral creature touching it takes 6d6 necrotic; a good creature takes 8d6 necrotic; such creatures take that damage again at the end of each turn holding/carrying it. An evil cleric or paladin may use it as a holy symbol and gains +2 spell attacks while wearing/holding it. It has 6 charges; as an action spend 1 charge and target a visible good creature on the ground within 120 feet: DC 20 Dexterity or a flaming fissure destroys it without remains, then closes. Spending the last charge destroys the talisman into foul slime.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:talking-doll.effectSummary: During a short rest while the doll is within 5 feet, program up to six phrases of no more than six words each and a trigger condition for each, or replace prior phrases. A trigger must occur within 5 feet of the doll, which then speaks its associated phrase. Programmed phrases are lost when attunement ends.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:tankard-of-plen.effectSummary: The tankard has 3 charges, all restored daily at dawn. While holding its handle, speak the command word to spend 1 charge and fill it with three pints of rich dwarven ale.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:tashas-creeping.effectSummary: Magic 10-by-30-foot four-legged boat with walking and swimming speed 20 feet, unable to travel underwater. While riding it, direct its movement verbally; creatures you choose aboard gain +1 AC. Carries up to 1,000 pounds normally or up to 2,000 pounds at half speed.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:tearulai.effectSummary: Sentient neutral-good sword of sharpness for a non-evil creature; its magic is suppressed until removed from Valdemar's skull. Against objects, maximize weapon damage dice. On attack-roll 20 against a creature, deal +14 slashing, then roll d20; another 20 severs a limb or body portion as DM determines. Command word toggles bright light 10 feet/dim another 10. Evil creatures cannot attune; attempting deals 20 psychic. Its emerald blade cannot be damaged/dulled and while attuned it cannot be teleported without its wielder. It has 6 charges, regaining 1d4+2 daily at dawn; cast fly 2, polymorph 3, or transport via plants 4 without material components. Sentience: Intelligence 17, Wisdom 12, Charisma 20, hearing/truesight 120 feet, telepathic, speaks/reads/understands Common, Draconic, Elvish, Sylvan, and knows the true value of gems within 5 feet. It prizes beauty and gemstones and longs to return to Myth Drannor, potentially entering item conflict if the wielder opposes that goal.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:teeth-of-dahlve.effectSummary: Artifact pouch of 20 unique teeth. As an action draw one randomly; each used tooth is permanently removed, and rerolled used results become the next lowest unused tooth. Either sow it in open ground/requisite water, summoning its listed allied creatures for 10 minutes unless noted, or implant it in your mouth, replacing one tooth and granting its listed effect; maximum implanted teeth is 1 + Constitution modifier, minimum 2, with excess implants randomly replacing a prior one. An unplanted/unimplanted tooth resolves randomly at turn end: even vanishes and summons its creatures hostile to you/allies, odd implants itself. You cannot remove implanted teeth or voluntarily end attunement; a removed tooth after death vanishes. When all teeth vanish, pouch reappears elsewhere with a full set. Destroy a tooth permanently only by sowing it at the location where its story originated, in which case summoned creatures are not friendly and do not vanish. d20 table—1 Staring Cats: summons 9 cats; implanted has 8 charges, action 1 charge revivify, and automatically spends 1 to revivify you if dead at turn start. 2 Duggle: 1 commoner; after each long rest sanctuary DC 18 on you for 24 hours/until broken. 3 Golden Age: 10 goblins + goblin boss; once per short/long rest when hit with ally within 5 feet, reaction redirects hit to ally. 4 Mill Road: 3 green hags in coven; when you damage target before it has acted in combat, +3d10 slashing. 5 Malpheggi: lizardfolk queen +4 lizardfolk; +2 AC from scales, but after long rest DC 15 Constitution or gain exhaustion. 6 Stable Hand: 2 incubi; add d10 to Charisma checks against humanoids, which become hostile at next dawn. 7 Donkey's Dream: unicorn; 3 charges restored at dawn, action 1 charge touch to heal 2d8+2 and remove all disease/poison; flaw compels opposition to witnessed wickedness. 8 Beyond Bral: 2 mind flayers; telepathy 120 feet and detect thoughts at will without components, but disadvantage on Insight and Perception. 9 Half Hollow: 4 giant toads; long jump 30 feet/high jump 15 feet without run-up. 10 Phantoms/Ghosts: giant octopus + mage + specter; once per dawn cast Evard's black tentacles DC 18. 11 Jander Sunstar: vampire; bite unarmed strike 1d6 piercing +3d6 necrotic and heal equal necrotic, but cannot heal in sunlight. 12 Kaggash: beholder; once per dawn cast eyebite; after every long rest roll d20, on 20 DM-chosen aberration appears within 30 feet and attacks. 13 Three Bridges: 3 oni; fly 30 feet and detect magic at will; if attuned to fewer than 3 magic items gain unremovable exhaustion until at least 3 attunements. 14 Claws of Dragotha: adult red dracolich; once per dawn cast create undead; each use also creates a skeleton/zombie/ghoul within 5 miles that hunts living creatures and propagates its type from humanoids killed at next midnight. 15 Ashes of Ages: dao + djinni + efreeti + marid; once per dawn counterspell at 9th level; if unused since previous long rest, after a long rest max HP drops 2d10, death at 0. 16 Daughters of Bel: pit fiend; once per dawn dominate monster DC 18; you smell strongly of sulfur. 17 Sky Screams: ancient blue dragon; lightning immunity, thunder vulnerability. 18 Last Tarrasque: tarrasque that ignores you/commands and lasts 1d4 rounds; double damage to objects/structures; after taking 20+ damage in one turn, DC 18 Wisdom or spend next turn in murderous fury attacking a damaging creature or random visible creature. 19 Incendax: ancient red dragon; fire immunity and action 90-foot cone DC 24 Dexterity, 26d6 fire or half; using it gives 2 exhaustion. 20 Dahlver-Nar: priest; once per 7 days use an action to request divine intervention, DM determines effect, with any cleric spell appropriate.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:teleportation-t.effectSummary: The tablet bears one permanent teleportation-circle sigil sequence. Studying it for 10 minutes and succeeding DC 21 Intelligence (Arcana) reveals the destination. As an action, break it and destroy it; if on the same plane as its destination circle, create a 10-foot-diameter temporary teleportation circle in a visible open ground space within 30 feet, linked to that destination, lasting until the end of your next turn.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:telescopic-tran.effectSummary: After 1 hour calibrating the enormous telescope on a planet or celestial body, make DC 17 Intelligence (Arcana). Success safely teleports you and up to eight willing creatures touching the telescope, plus gear, to open spaces at the intended destination. Failure causes d6 mishap: 1 travelers adrift in Astral Sea; 2 random/DM-chosen different plane; 3 telescope explodes, creatures within 60 feet take 8d6 necrotic and surviving humanoids are transformed as by reincarnate; 4 an Astral Sea creature such as a githyanki knight appears within 60 feet with DM-determined attitude; 5 travelers arrive on a different planet/celestial body in nearest Wildspace system; 6 correct destination but travelers are coated in harmless slime.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:tentacle-rod.effectSummary: As an action while holding the rod, direct all three tentacles to attack one visible creature within 15 feet. Each makes a +9 melee attack for 1d6 bludgeoning. If all three hit, target makes DC 15 Constitution or for 1 minute its speed is halved, it has disadvantage on Dexterity saves, cannot take reactions, and on its turns may take either an action or bonus action but not both; repeat the save at each turn end to end.
